name: Blue Line Phase 2B
scope: 38.44 km, Krishnarajapura (KR Puram) to Kempegowda International Airport, including Kempapura, Kalyan Nagar, Veerannapalya and HRBR Layout stations; part of Namma Metro Phase 2's Blue (Airport) Line. Construction began 2022-02.
pending: As of 2025-06-30, physical progress on the combined Phase 2A+2B corridor was 52.5%, financial progress 55.89% (PropNewz). Multiple stations under construction; planned opening December 2027, per The Metro Rail Guy.
notes: The combined Phase 2A+2B cost figure (₹14,788.101 cr, 58.19 km) is recorded once, on blue-line-phase-2a, to avoid double-counting in this site's aggregate totals — see that project's notes for the figure and its funding breakdown. One package-level contract specific to this phase is on file here: ₹182.33 cr for the Airport Depot at Doddajala (J Kumar–AIC Infrastructures JV, awarded 2023-03-21), a small fraction of the whole 38.44 km phase, not a project total.
